column1: # EXAMPLE ONLY — not read by kit.py. Shows the format of rule-selected.tsv.
# `kit.py import-rule` writes one row here per imported rule.
# upstream_file_path = exact file path in the repo (a SKILL.md, an AGENTS.md, ...)
# local_name        = file name under rules/ (becomes rules/<local_name>.md)
# kit_load          = always | glob | manual | model  (how the rule activates)
# imported_sha      = full commit sha the copy was taken from (drives update checks)
